summary: Download a pending backup or export
description:
Sends the file of a backup created without keep, or of a page export, as application/octet-stream. It works once: the file is removed after it is sent, and unfetched ones are removed after 30 minutes. Only the user who made it can fetch it. The name query parameter is the file name offered to the browser; an invalid one falls back to npmpro-backup.npmpro.
Needs: the signed-in user or token owner who created the backup or export

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The file name offered for the download, for example npmpro-backup-npmpro-20261117-093000.npmpro; only a valid backup or export name is used.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Pending download id returned by the create call

410.description: The id is unknown, malformed, expired (unfetched downloads are removed after 30 minutes), already fetched, or belongs to another user. The answer is an error such as {"error": {"code": 410, "message": "The restore session has expired", "message_i18n": "backup.error.token-expired"}}.
